action.description: Imperative containment action to execute (e.g. 'Suspend user account', 'Revoke OAuth token', 'Block outbound to 1.2.3.4/32').

target.description: Specific entity to act on: UPN, account name, IP CIDR, resource ARN, or device ID (e.g. 'jsmith@corp.example', '10.0.0.5/32', 'arn:aws:iam::123:user/svc-deploy').

platform.description: Platform where the action is executed. 'gws': Google Workspace. 'm365': Microsoft 365. 'aws': AWS IAM/console. 'okta': Okta. 'edr': endpoint agent (CrowdStrike, Defender). 'network': firewall/ACL. 'generic': other.

rollback.description: Exact steps to reverse this action if it was applied in error (e.g. 'Re-enable account via Admin Console > Users > jsmith > Activate').

blast_radius.description: Scope of impact if applied. 'single-user': one account affected. 'multi-user': multiple accounts or a group. 'multi-tenant': spans tenants or orgs. 'cross-platform': affects multiple integrated platforms.

note.description: Operator rationale, urgency, or caveats for the reviewer approving this action.

finding_slug.description: Slug of the finding that motivates this containment action (links the proposal to its evidence).
